title: Stupid but helpful
body:
I’ve struggled with drug addiction for 5 years. Thankfully to my loving family and friends they refused to ignore me pushing them away and help me. I’m now 11 months clean and every other day I open this app 
just to see how far I’ve come. 11 months seems like nothing but each time I look, I manage to make it longer and this app is so simple but helpful

title: Best sobriety counter app
body: I’ve tried various sobriety counter apps and this is by far my favourite. It’s simple and very easy to use, and the free version has so many functionalities, plus unlimited possible counters. It’s helped me not drink alcohol for over a year and taper down my caffeine consumption considerably, plus some other things I’ve managed to taper down or stop completely. This app has contributed significantly to my wellbeing and I’d highly recommended it to anyone.

body: Purchased the lifetime subscription right away. Some improvements/suggestions: using emojis to tag counters in addition to colors would be nice, especially for Apple Watch.
